description: Dignified portrait photograph of Shinya Yamanaka, Japanese scientist in his early 60s, short grey-black hair, wearing a suit, neutral background.
A used-car lot with rows of second-hand cars and price signs in windshields, illustrating Akerlof's market for lemons.
A clean infographic-style illustration of cognitive biases: a human head silhouette filled with gears, scales weighing gains versus losses, and an anchor symbol.
Artist's impression of the Sun-like star 51 Pegasi with a large hot-Jupiter gas giant planet orbiting very close to it, starfield background.
Scientific diagram-style image of a focused red laser beam through a microscope objective trapping a small transparent spherical bead at the focal point.
Abstract illustration of the physical constants of the universe balanced precariously on a knife edge above a starfield.
Green aurora borealis curtains rippling across a starry night sky over a snowy landscape with pine trees.
Portrait photograph of Artur Ekert, physicist with dark wavy hair and beard stubble, thoughtful expression, neutral background.
